description: This Swift source file extends the `FileHandle` class with safe reading methods that handle errors and avoid exceptions, providing safer alternatives to legacy APIs for reading data from files.

methods.name: readToEndSafely
methods.description: Reads data till EOF safely, returning an empty Data object on failure.

methods.name: readSafely(upToCount:)
methods.description: Reads up to a specified number of bytes safely, returning an empty Data object on failure or EOF.
